records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli
evidence: result:spec-guard was updated from 0.29.0 to 0.30.0 for scope user; the cached plugin is file-for-file identical to git archive v0.30.0 apart from the host's .in_use marker

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-hook
evidence: host:claude -p --no-session-persistence --tools '' --include-hook-events --output-format stream-json ran twice with PATH=~/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin, so the hook could only use the macOS system python3 3.9.6
result:both session inits loaded spec-guard 0.30.0 from the plugin cache and UserPromptSubmit exited 0 each time
result:in a temporary local-mode consumer repository whose activeModule alpha had a plan but no todo while beta was unfinished, the hook injected MODULE_DONE with the missing-todo note
result:with the same repository and state.json tracker set to gitlab, the hook injected MODULE_DONE without the note
limit:the verify-artifacts summary and the DONE-stage placement of the note were not exercised on the host; test-verify-artifacts.sh and test-phase-guard.sh cover them
